pairs: Petite a Domino pluviam in tempore serotino,
Petition before the Lord for rain in the latter time,
et Dominus faciet nives:
and the Lord will produce snows
et pluviam imbris dabit eis,
and will give showers of rain to them,
singulis herbam in agro.
to each blade in the field.
Quia simulacra locuta sunt inutile,
For the images have been speaking what is useless,
et divini viderunt mendacium:
and the diviners have seen a lie,
et somniatores locuti sunt frustra,
and the dreamers have been speaking false hope:
vane consolabantur:
they have comforted in vain.
idcirco abducti sunt quasi grex:
For this reason, they have been led away like a flock;
affligentur, quia non est eis pastor.
they will be afflicted, because they have no shepherd.
Super pastores iratus est furor meus,
My fury has been kindled over the shepherds,
et super hircos visitabo:
and I will visit upon the he-goats.
quia visitavit Dominus exercituum gregem suum,
For the Lord of hosts has visited his flock,
domum Juda,
the house of Judah,
et posuit eos quasi equum gloriæ suæ in bello.
and he has set them like the horse of his glory in the war.
Ex ipso angulus,
From him will go forth the angle,
ex ipso paxillus,
from him the wooden peg,
ex ipso arcus prælii,
from him the bow of battle,
ex ipso egredietur omnis exactor simul.
from him every exactor at the same time.
Et erunt quasi fortes conculcantes lutum viarum in prælio,
And they will be like the strong, trampling the mud of the ways in battle.
et bellabunt,
And they will fight,
quia Dominus cum eis:
for the Lord is with them.
et confundentur ascensores equorum.
And the riders of the horses will be confounded.
Et confortabo domum Juda,
And I will strengthen the house of Judah,
et domum Joseph salvabo:
and I will save the house of Joseph,
et convertam eos,
and I will convert them,
quia miserebor eorum:
because I will have mercy on them.
et erunt sicut fuerunt quando non projeceram eos:
And they will be as they were when I had not cast them away.
ego enim Dominus Deus eorum,
For I am the Lord their God,
et exaudiam eos.
and I will hear them.
Et erunt quasi fortes Ephraim,
And they will be like the strong of Ephraim,
et lætabitur cor eorum quasi a vino:
and their heart will rejoice as if by wine,
et filii eorum videbunt,
and their sons will see
et lætabuntur,
and will rejoice,
et exsultabit cor eorum in Domino.
and their heart will exult in the Lord.
Sibilabo eis,
I will whistle for them,
et congregabo illos,
and I will gather them together,
quia redemi eos:
because I have redeemed them.
et multiplicabo eos sicut ante fuerant multiplicati.
And I will multiply them, as they had been multiplied before.
Et seminabo eos in populis,
And I will sow them among the peoples,
et de longe recordabuntur mei:
and from far away they will remember me.
et vivent cum filiis suis,
And they will live with their sons,
et revertentur.
and they will return.
Et reducam eos de terra Ægypti,
And I will lead them back from the land of Egypt,
et de Assyriis congregabo eos,
and I will gather them from among the Assyrians,
et ad terram Galaad et Libani adducam eos,
and I will lead them to the land of Gilead and Lebanon,
et non invenietur eis locus:
and no place will be left that has not been found by them.
et transibit in maris freto,
And he will pass over the narrow passage of the sea,
et percutiet in mari fluctus,
and he will strike the waves of the sea,
et confundentur omnia profunda fluminis:
and all the depths of the river will be confounded,
et humiliabitur superbia Assur,
and the arrogance of Assyria will be brought low,
et sceptrum Ægypti recedet.
and the scepter of Egypt will withdraw.
Confortabo eos in Domino,
I will strengthen them in the Lord,
et in nomine ejus ambulabunt,
and they will walk in his name,
dicit Dominus.
says the Lord.
